rendered: The review does not say DRX cathodes are already produced at scale by coprecipitation. It actually states that DRX materials are generally synthesized in gram-scale quantities using energy-intensive mechanochemical and solid-state methods, and that synthesis of DRX cathodes using more scalable routes (e.g., coprecipitation) are needed to better assess their commercial viability.
